root_cause: The field hash->hashValue is declared OPTIONAL (ASN1_OPT) in the OSSL_HASH ASN.1 template, meaning the decoder may leave it NULL. The i2r_HASH() printing function introduced alongside this new extension never checked for that NULL case before passing hash->hashValue->data/length to the hex-printing helper, assuming the field was always present.
findings: The OSSL_HASH ASN1 structure defines hashValue as an OPTIONAL field (ASN1_OPT(OSSL_HASH, hashValue, ASN1_BIT_STRING)). The i2r_HASH() print routine, used when rendering the attributeDescriptor X.509v3 extension (reachable from CRL/certificate extension printing), unconditionally dereferences hash->hashValue->data and hash->hashValue->length without first checking that hash->hashValue is non-NULL.
